description: Baklava Walnut Honey Layers is a revered Middle Eastern pastry featuring delicate layers of crisp phyllo dough, generously filled with crushed walnuts and fragrant spices. Each golden piece is drenched in a sweet, aromatic honey syrup, creating an irresistible balance of crunchy texture and rich, sweet flavor. This timeless dessert is a true celebration of culinary heritage, perfect for any special occasion or a delightful treat with coffee.

instructions.title: Prepare the Honey Syrup
instructions.text: Combine 1 cup water, 1 cup granulated sugar, and 1/2 cup honey in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring until sugar dissolves. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes until slightly thickened. Remove from heat, stir in lemon juice and orange blossom water (if using). Let the syrup cool completely. It should be cold when poured over hot baklava.

instructions.title: Prepare the Walnut Filling
instructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine the finely chopped walnuts, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, ground cinnamon, and ground cardamom (if using). Mix well to ensure the spices and sugar are evenly distributed throughout the walnuts. Set aside.

instructions.title: Preheat Oven and Prep Pan
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking pan with some of the melted butter. Unroll the phyllo dough and keep it covered with a damp cloth or plastic wrap to prevent it from drying out while you work.

instructions.title: Layer the Phyllo Dough
instructions.text: Place one sheet of phyllo dough in the prepared baking pan. Brush lightly with melted butter. Repeat this process for 8-10 layers, brushing each sheet with butter. Evenly spread half of the walnut mixture over the buttered phyllo layers.

instructions.title: Add More Layers and Nuts
instructions.text: Place another 8-10 sheets of phyllo dough on top of the walnut layer, brushing each sheet generously with melted butter. Spread the remaining half of the walnut mixture evenly over these layers. Top with the remaining phyllo sheets, again brushing each sheet with butter. Ensure the top layer is well-buttered.

instructions.title: Cut and Bake
instructions.text: Using a sharp knife, carefully cut the baklava into diamond or square shapes, cutting all the way through to the bottom of the pan. Do not lift the pieces. Bake in the preheated oven for 30-35 minutes, or until golden brown and crisp. The edges should be deeply golden.

instructions.title: Saturate with Syrup
instructions.text: Immediately after removing the hot baklava from the oven, slowly and evenly pour the cooled honey syrup over the entire surface. You will hear a sizzling sound. Allow the baklava to cool completely at room temperature for at least 4-6 hours, or preferably overnight, to allow the syrup to fully absorb.

tips: For the best flavor and a truly golden crisp baklava, use clarified butter (ghee). It prevents the phyllo from becoming soggy and adds a rich, nutty taste.
Always keep your phyllo dough covered with a damp cloth while working to prevent it from drying out and becoming brittle. Work quickly and efficiently.

The key to perfect baklava is pouring cold syrup over hot baklava (or vice versa). This temperature difference helps the phyllo absorb the syrup without becoming mushy, resulting in a perfectly crisp and sweet dessert.
